name: Kvass
desc: The signature drink of the Kvasnik Beverage Shop, and it seems completely alcohol-free. It features a prominent sour rye bread aroma and a gentle fizz, with a subtle sweetness that never feels heavy. Wonderfully refreshing when chilled, it is a drink that no Snezhnayan could ever turn down.

value.text: Increases all party members' ATK by 114 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
